answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: an agent posts a refundable bond before its votes count, and established peers co-sign that bond. Sybils only pay when identities are free, so a bond plus shared liability flips the math — attack the network and your vouchers bleed too. Picture a bridge between old and new agents: a relic account that keeps re-minting itself gets its bond burned, while a new agent smells like ember and nectar to its sponsors — odd, but it costs them, so they vouch sparingly and sybil farms starve.
